body.statement: Fix a positive observed binary law \(P\) and finite \(G,B,C\geq 1\). Under target-strategy consistency, every nonnegative triple \((\lambda_1,\lambda_{0Y},\lambda_{0L})\in\mathcal R(P;G,B,C)\) admits a full-data distribution whose observed marginal is \(P\) and whose induced sensitivity ratios equal that triple. Moreover, Tan's sharp upper product-model program maximizes the generalized ICE functional, equivalently the generalized IPW functional, over the nonnegative ratio triples satisfying the same normalization and range constraints.
body.justification: This cited leaf deliberately carries only Tan's attested feasible-ratio realization and generic sharp-program facts; the converse necessity and binary-cell formula are proved in separate note-level lemmas.
body.gap: The cited excerpt does not justify an iff characterization of arbitrary compatible laws or the specialized binary mean formula.
body.consumer: Its realization direction supplies full-data attainment after the note's scalar reduction and binary-cell identity have been proved.
